workLog.action: Observed PR #3636 reporting CONFLICTING while git merge-tree exited 0 against the same two commits.
workLog.outcome: Local git and the GitHub API disagreed, so one of them was wrong about the same merge.

workLog.action: Polled gh pr view four times at 30 second intervals on the correct head SHA.
workLog.outcome: CONFLICTING/DIRTY every time. Ruled out a stale mergeability cache.

workLog.action: Ran a throwaway worktree merge of origin/main.
workLog.outcome: Exit 0, Automatic merge went well, with causal-graph.json auto-merged. The conflict was not real locally.

workLog.action: Checked git check-attr and git config for a custom merge driver on the graph.
workLog.outcome: Found merge=causal-graph at .gitattributes:541, driver registered by scripts/maintenance/install_merge_drivers.py. GitHub does not run custom drivers, which explains the disagreement.

workLog.action: Merged origin/main into the branch and pushed, then compared node counts across HEAD, HEAD^1, and HEAD^2.
workLog.outcome: Status moved to MERGEABLE. Merged graph had 2616 nodes against 2575 and 2586, confirming a union rather than a discarded side.

workLog.action: Tested whether the finding generalizes by diagnosing PR #3497, which had also gone CONFLICTING.
workLog.outcome: Negative result that sharpened the memory: 3497 auto-merged the graph but carried a real conflict in src/copilot-cli/.claude-plugin/plugin.json. CONFLICTING does not always mean the false conflict, so the memory prescribes a local test merge before acting.
